summary: A user-facing screen or component: design brief in, tokens only, loading, empty, error and gated states, model output labeled, browser smoke with zero console errors.

required_inputs.name: design_brief
required_inputs.description: The df-design brief or canvas direction the screen implements

required_inputs.name: data_source
required_inputs.description: The endpoint or store the screen reads and writes

required_inputs.name: closest_screen
required_inputs.description: The existing screen to match, by path

required_inputs.name: feature_key
required_inputs.description: Entitlement gate, or none with a reason

checklist.rule: A design brief or a decided canvas direction is an input; an undecided direction means ask, never pick
checklist.because: Flex import wizard and r3cruit3r match-and-merge canvases are undecided; a screen built on a guess is rebuilt

checklist.rule: Colors, radii and type come from the theme or token file; no literal hex, no second UI library, no forbidden import
checklist.because: r3cruit3r has 829 legacy hex hits and 23 react-toastify files that the theme does not control; LINDA tokens feed three consumers from one file

checklist.rule: Loading, empty, error and, when gated, the upgrade state exist in the component, not only in a route-level shell
checklist.because: Every repo's design section says so; LINDA has no loading.tsx or error.tsx so the shell cannot cover it; Flex says never render a blank page

checklist.rule: Anything a model produced is labeled as such and shows what it was derived from
checklist.because: Flex AI output carries a visible label; LINDA cites the transcript span; r3cruit3r merge surfaces have a coach accepting a machine judgment

checklist.rule: A destructive or irreversible action confirms first and states what it will do in plain words
checklist.because: r3cruit3r merge, reject and bulk import; LINDA export of transcript text needs an explicit user action

checklist.rule: Shell, header pattern, table primitive and form library match the closest existing screen
checklist.because: Every CLAUDE.md: when in doubt, match the closest existing screen; LINDA screens must also survive Flex's shell

checklist.rule: A gated screen wraps in the gate component and its data route asserts the feature server-side
checklist.because: Flex widgets fired gated calls for every tier and logged a 402 per load

checklist.rule: The screen renders in a real browser with zero console errors and no failed requests; the receipt is attached
checklist.because: Quadratus browser.py produces evidence, reviewers produce judgment; type-checks do not catch a late throw

checklist.rule: Copy passes the writing rules: no em dashes, no AI tells; identifiers a user reads aloud use the mono font where the design says so
checklist.because: r3cruit3r mono for recruit ids and timestamps; the df-writing hard rules apply to every repo

checklist.rule: The screen is checked against every theme the repo ships: dark only, both, or the tenant override
checklist.because: LINDA dark first with a light override; Flex must hold up under another tenant's brand; r3cruit3r is dark only

done_output: the four states, each with its component location
model output label and provenance, or none
browser smoke receipt: console errors zero, failed requests zero
stop_conditions: no brief and the direction is undecided
the data source does not exist yet
the task asks for a literal color or a second UI library
the screen would export transcript or PII without an explicit user action

adapter_fields.name: token_source
adapter_fields.description: Theme file or token file the screen reads

adapter_fields.name: forbidden_imports
adapter_fields.description: Libraries that must not appear, for example react-toastify

adapter_fields.name: state_components
adapter_fields.description: Existing loading, empty, error and gate components to reuse

adapter_fields.name: gate_hook
adapter_fields.description: useFeature, FeatureGate, or the repo equivalent

adapter_fields.name: themes_to_check
adapter_fields.description: dark only, both, or tenant override

adapter_fields.name: shell_constraint
adapter_fields.description: For example: must survive Flex's shell, no own top nav

adapter_fields.name: smoke_command
adapter_fields.description: How to render the page in a real browser and collect console errors
